|Class |Type |Definition

|`gloss:Abbreviation` |owl:Class |A shortened form of a word or phrase (acronym, initialism, or truncation).
|`gloss:AbstractNaryRelation` |owl:Class |Abstract base shape for all n-ary concept-system relations. Declares the shared fields: comprehensive, members[2..*], completeness, criterion, sources, notes, status. Concrete leaves: PartitiveRelation, GenericRelation, future AssociativeRelation / SequentialRelation. See docs/design/abstract-nary-relation.md.
|`gloss:Citation` |owl:Class |A bibliographic citation. The ref field is always a structured CitationRef hash (source + id + optional version). Never a plain string in V3. Used as the origin of ConceptSource. Corresponds to Citation in glossarist-ruby.
|`gloss:CitationRef` |owl:Class |Inner reference of a Citation — always a structured hash with source, id, and optional version. Never a plain string in V3. Corresponds to Citation::Ref in glossarist-ruby.
|`gloss:Concept` |owl:Class |A managed terminology concept — the top-level entity in Glossarist. Has status, dates, domains, related concepts, and localizations. Corresponds to ManagedConcept in glossarist-ruby.
|`gloss:ConceptCollection` |owl:Class |A managed collection of concepts (a glossary or register). Corresponds to ManagedConceptCollection in glossarist-ruby.
|`gloss:ConceptDate` |owl:Class |MANAGEMENT: A governance event in the concept or localization lifecycle. Types include acceptance, amendment, retirement, review, and review decision. Inspired by TBX <transactionGrp> (ISO 30042).
|`gloss:ConceptRef` |owl:Class |A reference to a concept in another registry or vocabulary. Has source, id, and optional text. No version, locality, or link. Used as the ref of RelatedConcept. Corresponds to ConceptRef in glossarist-ruby.
|`gloss:ConceptSource` |owl:Class |Bibliographic source with type (authoritative/lineage), status (identical/modified/...), and an origin citation.
|`gloss:ConceptSystem` |owl:Class |A structured set of concepts established according to the relations between them, each concept being determined by its position in the set (ISO 12620 A.7.1). Promotes the previously-implicit concept system to a first-class entity. Lives per-file at concept-systems/<id>.yaml. See docs/design/concept-systems.md.
|`gloss:ConceptSystemMember` |owl:Class |Abstract base shape for members of any n-ary concept-system relation (PartitiveMember, GenericMember, future AssociativeMember). Carries the shared MECE dimensions: presence (required/optional), count (exactly_one/at_least_one/multiple), is_delimiting (boolean). The three dimensions are orthogonal. The combination (optional, at_least_one) is invalid and collapses to (optional, multiple). See docs/design/abstract-nary-relation.md for the rationale.
|`gloss:ConceptSystemType` |owl:Class |ISO 12620 A.7.1 concept system type: generic \| partitive \| sequential \| associative \| mixed.
|`gloss:CustomLocality` |owl:Class |A custom name-value locality pair within a citation.
|`gloss:DatasetRegister` |owl:Class |Self-describing dataset metadata (register.yaml). Each dataset directory contains a register.yaml that carries identity, structure, and relationship metadata. Corresponds to DatasetRegister in the Lutaml model.
|`gloss:Designation` |owl:Class |Abstract base for all designation types. A designation is both a gloss:Designation and a skosxl:Label. The skosxl:literalForm carries the designation text. Corresponds to Designation::Base in glossarist-ruby.
|`gloss:DesignationRelationship` |owl:Class |A designation-level relationship between two designations of the same concept (ISO 10241-1). Unlike RelatedConcept (which links concepts by identifier), DesignationRelationship links designations by their text. Types include abbreviated_form_for and short_form_for.
|`gloss:DetailedDefinition` |owl:Class |A definition, note, or example with optional per-item sources. Uses rdf:value for the text content.
|`gloss:Expression` |owl:Class |A word or phrase used as a designation.
|`gloss:Figure` |owl:Class |A dataset-level figure entity with localized caption/alt and multiple image variants. May contain recursive subfigures.
|`gloss:FigureImage` |owl:Class |One image variant within a Figure (format, role, dimensions).
|`gloss:Formula` |owl:Class |A dataset-level formula entity with localized expression.
|`gloss:GenericMember` |owl:Class |One member of a GenericRelation — a specific concept (species) plus ISO 704:2022 presence, count, and delimiting metadata. Same MECE shape as PartitiveMember.
|`gloss:GenericRelation` |owl:Class |ISO 704 / ISO 1087-1 / ISO 12620 generic relation. Connects a comprehensive concept (the genus) to two or more specific concepts (the species) which together constitute a decomposition by some criterion of subdivision. Shown as a rake or bracket in source diagrams (ISO 704 §5.5.4.1). All species within one relation are coordinate concepts. Distinct from binary broader_generic / narrower_generic edges. A single species should be expressed as a binary edge, not a GenericRelation. Justified by OIML V 2-200:2010 evidence (~8 generic hyperedges, several with 6+ criterion groups). See docs/design/generic-relation.md. Stored per-file at relations/<comprehensive-id>/<slug>.yaml.
|`gloss:GrammarInfo` |owl:Class |Grammatical information about a designation: gender, number, part of speech.
|`gloss:GraphicalSymbol` |owl:Class |An iconic or graphical symbol.
|`gloss:LetterSymbol` |owl:Class |A single letter used as a symbol.
|`gloss:Locality` |owl:Class |A locality within a cited document (section, clause, page, etc.).
|`gloss:LocalizedConcept` |owl:Class |A concept in a specific language. Contains designations, definition, notes, examples, sources. Linked to its managed concept via gloss:isLocalizationOf. Corresponds to LocalizedConcept in glossarist-ruby.
|`gloss:NonConceptEntity` |owl:Class |A dataset-shared entity that is NOT a concept: Figure, Table, Formula. Has stable dataset-wide identity. Distinct from NonVerbRep (which is a concept-local non-verbal designation) and from NonVerbalRepresentation (which is a designation modality of a concept). A figure illustrates a concept; it does not designate it. Calling it "non-verbal" was a category error — non-verbal refers to the modality of expression, not the ontological category. These are non-concept entities that happen to use visual/tabular/formulaic modality.
|`gloss:NonVerbalEntity` |owl:Class |Abstract base for all non-verbal representation entities (ISO 10241-1 §6.5). Carries the shared accessibility + provenance payload: caption, description, alt, sources.
|`gloss:NonVerbalRepresentation` |owl:Class |Reference to an external image, table, or formula resource (ISO 10241-1 §6.5).
|`gloss:PartitiveMember` |owl:Class |One member of a PartitiveRelation — a partitive concept (via ConceptRef) plus ISO 704:2022 presence, count, and delimiting metadata. presence + count decompose the line notation: presence (required/optional) encodes the line style (solid/dashed), count (exactly_one/at_least_one/multiple) encodes the line count. is_delimiting is orthogonal: a delimiting part behaves like a delimiting characteristic, distinguishing the comprehensive from coordinate concepts (ISO 704 bold 3x-width line).
|`gloss:PartitiveRelation` |owl:Class |ISO 704 / ISO 1087-1 / ISO 12620 partitive relation. Connects a comprehensive concept (superordinate concept partitive) to two or more partitive concepts (subordinate concepts partitive) which fitted together constitute the comprehensive. Shown as a rake or bracket in source diagrams. All partitives within one relation are coordinate concepts (ISO 12620): they share the comprehensive AND the criterion of subdivision. Glossarist extensions beyond ISO notation: - criterion as structured multilingual data - Per-member presence + count (ISO 704:2022 MECE decomposition of the diagram line notation: required/optional × exactly_one/at_least_one/multiple) - is_delimiting (ISO 704 delimiting part, bold 3x-width line) Distinct from binary has_part / is_part_of edges, which express pairwise part-of assertions without completeness claims. Stored per-file at relations/<comprehensive-id>/<slug>.yaml — see docs/design/relations-as-files.md.
|`gloss:Prefix` |owl:Class |A prefix that attaches before a designation (ISO 12620).
|`gloss:Pronunciation` |owl:Class |A pronunciation or transcription entry for a designation. Supports IPA, romanization, and other transcription systems.
|`gloss:Reference` |owl:Class |A typed reference to an item within a collection. Used for domain classification (ManagedConceptData#domains) and typed references (ConceptData#references). For bibliographic citations, use gloss:Citation. For concept links in relationships, use gloss:ConceptRef.
|`gloss:RelatedConcept` |owl:Class |A concept with a typed relationship (deprecates, broader, equivalent, etc.). Binary: one source concept, one target concept via a ConceptRef. For one-to-many partitive decompositions (ISO 704 rake), use gloss:PartitiveRelation. For ExternalConcept resolution, use gloss:provides / gloss:providedBy.
|`gloss:Section` |owl:Class |A structural division within a dataset. Sections can be hierarchical: a section may contain child sections (e.g. Part > Section > Subsection) via gloss:hasChildSection.
|`gloss:Suffix` |owl:Class |A suffix that attaches after a designation (ISO 12620).
|`gloss:Symbol` |owl:Class |A non-letter symbol representing a concept.
|`gloss:Table` |owl:Class |A dataset-level table entity with localized content.
